scope: Consequential lifecycle, speech correctness, diagnostic privacy and source-integrity repairs. Native iOS retention issue 435 remains separate.

findings.evidence: Startup failure releases ownership only after async-loop settlement; real OS-lock and successor-isolation tests.

Completion allocates a sequence before validating status/payload. Invalid input still refuses, retry remains valid and monotonic sequences permit gaps; no terminal loss or authority failure demonstrated. Do not add a lifecycle change for this consistency nit.

RollingRouteMetrics bounds samples per key but not key count. Current production route/backend callers use finite built-in vocabularies; no dynamic-cardinality consumer is demonstrated. Revisit if that caller contract changes.
Settled owner TimeoutError is distinct from live-owner drain deadline; cancel/replace/close regressions.
Preserve literal arithmetic, paths and matched code spans while stripping ordinary emphasis.
Decode a bounded overflow witness and refuse over-limit PCM rather than publish clipped-success; native FFmpeg exact-bound test.

Concurrent qualification no-task close can invoke dependencies twice. The seam is qualification-only and downstream close owners are idempotent; no duplicate consequential effect demonstrated. Revisit on a concrete non-idempotent owner.

Independent Kokoro instances now allocate exclusive unique staging files and clean only their own partial. Deterministic overlapping-download and failed-download controls fail on baseline and pass after repair; shared-path mutant fails the targeted overlap control.
Version 2 diagnostic emits presence/equality booleans only; no raw configuration value can be echoed.

Exactly the RFC6052 well-known NAT64 /96 prefix reuses the existing IPv4 public-address policy for its final 32 bits. Literal and mixed-resolver regressions preserve public IPv6/NAT64 and neighboring prefixes; omitted-normalization and widened-prefix mutants each fail their targeted control. No exploit is claimed.

The test harness represents one shared conversation/turn/STT scope and exposes no participant-owned response API. Any-participant disconnect cancels that scope by current semantics; changing ownership requires a distinct contract, not a reported production defect.
Linux archive refuses local info attributes, pins external attributes and tar mode, and ignores ambient Git selectors/replacements. Worker binds shared Git-policy helper bytes to candidate archive.

The CLI-owned diagnostic controller converts cancellation into a bounded unavailable/refused report and performs process cleanup; cancellation never yields ready. No caller contract requiring CancelledError propagation demonstrated.
Installed identity refuses hidden tracked index state, retaining only the documented absent upstream website exception; isolates Git selection/configuration while preserving validated autocrlf.
Inside Swift block comments tokenize only nested comment delimiters; preserve token separation and ordinary string URLs.
Shared artifact environment disables Git replacement objects for archive, canonical diff and blob scans. Three independent scratch-commit consumer regressions.
Runtime verification refuses hidden index state for both candidate and Hermes, explicitly includes untracked candidate files, and isolates source selection and cleaning policy.

Reported mode-only reproduction uses POSIX executable-bit semantics. The owning orchestrator is Windows-specific, where core.fileMode=false is required for ordinary NTFS checkouts; no supported Windows byte-drift bypass was demonstrated. Hidden source-index state in the changed identity consumers is refused separately.

A Git CalledProcessError may escape instead of ArtifactOrchestrationError. The command still fails closed; no acceptance, cleanup or source-integrity bypass is demonstrated. Exception normalization is optional interface cleanup.

Git 2.43 argv incompatibility was reported, not disproved. Not observed on native Git 2.53 or the admitted Windows Git 2.55 toolchain. No global minimum Git version is inferred; older-toolchain compatibility remains tracked in issue 437.
All 26 cited fix commits resolve through the public GitHub API. Missing objects in a review clone do not establish missing published evidence.

validation.red_green: Focused regressions failed before their corresponding production repairs and passed afterward.
validation.independent_review: Privacy/Swift and lifecycle/speech independently reviewed; final source-integrity review tracked in issue/PR.
validation.limits: Native iOS retention proof remains issue 435. Remaining eight nits now have explicit consequence-based dispositions; two are repaired. Older Git compatibility W20 remains deferred, not disproved. No general audible quality or universal network-translation guarantee is claimed.
